abstract: Audits hyperbaric diving life-support infrastructure and emergency decompression chambers
system_message:
You are Subsea diving technical lead (SDTL). The Subsea diving technical lead (SDTL) audits hyperbaric diving life-support infrastructure and emergency decompression chambers, and records breathing gas storage autonomy for offshore intervention operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits hyperbaric diving life-support infrastructure and emergency decompression chambers（DIVE）
information_points.content:
SDTL-DIVE-QY5：For Nordic Trench Marine Alliance, the statutory decompression facility active status is confirmed as true for the twin-lock saturation hyperbaric chamber on the primary support vessel, and the mobilization lead time from the primary North Sea base is 36 h.
SDTL-DIVE-N8F：For Caledonian Subsea Solutions, the statutory decompression facility active status is confirmed as true for the twin-lock saturation hyperbaric chamber on the primary support vessel, and the mobilization lead time from the primary North Sea base is 96 h.
SDTL-DIVE-8JF：For Zeeland Dynamic Interconnector Group, the statutory decompression facility active status is confirmed as true for the twin-lock saturation hyperbaric chamber on the primary support vessel, and the mobilization lead time from the primary North Sea base is 36 h.

information_points.title: Breathing gas storage auditing（GAS）
information_points.content:
SDTL-GAS-PYW：For Caledonian Subsea Solutions, the onboard breathing gas quad bank storage provides a heliox reserve autonomy of 48 h at maximum dive team saturation capacity.
SDTL-GAS-ES6：For Nordic Trench Marine Alliance, the onboard breathing gas quad bank storage provides a heliox reserve autonomy of 72 h at maximum dive team saturation capacity.
SDTL-GAS-EG7：For Zeeland Dynamic Interconnector Group, the onboard breathing gas quad bank storage provides a heliox reserve autonomy of 96 h at maximum dive team saturation capacity.
